chunks: From him, from Musa ibn 'Umayr, from al-Hasan ibn Yusuf, from Nasr, from Muhammad ibn Hashim, from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (peace be upon him), who said:
"When the virgin girl, who is nine years old, is married, she is not considered makhdu'ah (deceived/inexperienced in marital matters)."
ai.seo_question: What is the legal status of a nine-year-old virgin girl in Shia marriage jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the legal status of a virgin girl who reaches the age of nine, declaring her 'makhdu'ah' (not deceived/inexperienced). This ruling signifies that she possesses sufficient maturity and discernment to be considered suitable for marriage and consummation, thereby validating her consent without requiring additional proof of physical or mental maturity beyond this specific age threshold in classical Shia jurisprudence.
